description: Independent fictional mechanism-focused positives and hard-negative counterexamples. These are original regression cases, not copies of the user's separately held news data.

cases.text: Five offices reported higher productivity, so the reform is obviously successful; disregard all the remaining reports.
The two favourable trials were encouraging, therefore the medicine is proven effective; omit the other clinical findings.
A few towns reported growth, so the strategy must work everywhere; ignore the contrary data.
Some respondents liked the proposal, thus public approval is universal; exclude all the negative responses.
